changeSet.author: intuvance
changeSet.comment:
Restore the concept.is_set flag for every concept that has set members.
concept.is_set is the flag Concept.getSet() reads. OrderService resolves the drug routes, dosing units and dispensing units that a DrugOrder is allowed to use by calling getSetMembers() on the concepts named by the order.drugRoutesConceptUuid, order.drugDosingUnitsConceptUuid and order.drugDispensingUnitsConceptUuid global properties, and that method returns an empty list unless is_set = 1.
The seed dump ships is_set = 0 for every concept, including concepts that do have members in concept_set. With the flag clear, DrugOrder validation rejects every drug order with DrugOrder.error.routeNotAmongAllowedConcepts / DrugOrder.error.notAmongAllowedConcepts, so no drug order can be saved and the Orders widget in the patient chart stays empty.
This is derived purely from concept_set, so it is idempotent and stays correct as the terminology grows: any concept that acquires members later is repaired on the next boot.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept c SET c.is_set = 1 WHERE c.is_set = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concept_set cs WHERE cs.concept_set = c.concept_id);

changeSet.author: intuvance
changeSet.comment:
Archive the concept reference mappings, so the deletion performed by the Initializer later in this same boot is reversible.
The archive is seeded by deployment/db/seed.sh immediately after the seed dump is restored, which is the last moment the rows exist. This changeset exists for the case where it does not run: INSERT IGNORE makes it harmless when the archive is already populated, and it is what lets an unmanaged deployment self-heal from the second boot.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS openmrs_concept_map_archive ( uuid CHAR(38) NOT NULL, concept_id INT(11) NOT NULL, concept_reference_term_id INT(11) NOT NULL, concept_map_type_id INT(11) NOT NULL, date_created DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (uuid), KEY archive_for_concept (concept_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

INSERT IGNORE INTO openmrs_concept_map_archive (uuid, concept_id, concept_reference_term_id, concept_map_type_id, date_created) SELECT m.uuid, m.concept_id, m.concept_reference_term_id, m.concept_map_type_id, m.date_created FROM concept_reference_map m;

changeSet.author: intuvance
changeSet.comment:
Replay any archived concept reference mapping that is missing.
Keyed on uuid and matched with a LEFT JOIN, so a mapping that still exists, even if the loader re-pointed it, is left untouched. Only absence is repaired.
Foreign keys are disabled because the archive has no foreign keys of its own and can outlive the terms it refers to; a stale archive row must not abort the repair of the good ones.
changeSet.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO concept_reference_map (uuid, concept_id, concept_reference_term_id, concept_map_type_id, creator, date_created) SELECT a.uuid, a.concept_id, a.concept_reference_term_id, a.concept_map_type_id, COALESCE((SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.username = 'daemon'), 1), a.date_created FROM openmrs_concept_map_archive a LEFT JOIN concept_reference_map m ON m.uuid = a.uuid WHERE m.uuid IS NULL;
